headline_hindi: Bharat mein pariksha leak ne Gen Z ke liye naukri sankat ko ujagar kiya
summary_hindi: Bharat mein ek pariksha leak ne Gen Z ke liye naukri sankat ko ujagar kiya hai, jo ki bahut gahra hai. Is leak ke kaaran kayi yuvaon ki naukri ki ummeeden toot gayi hain. Iska impact bharatiya arthvyavastha par bhi padega.
poster_headline: Pariksha Leak: Gen Z ke liye naukri sankat
short_script: Bharat mein pariksha leak ne Gen Z ke liye naukri sankat ko ujagar kiya hai, jo ki bahut gahra hai, is leak ke kaaran kayi yuvaon ki naukri ki ummeeden toot gayi hain, ab hum iska hal nikalne ki koshish kar rahe hain
